text: Buckets multiply: the emptiest bucket pays the most per point.
detail: Final DMG, skill amp, boss DMG, crit and element are separate factors; inside each, buffs add.

text: Skill amp is one additive bucket: +1 point ≈ 1% ÷ (1 + total amp) more damage.
detail: At 100% amp a point is +0.5%; at 122%, +0.45%. Anything past that comes from buffers' amp growing their amp-scaled buffs.

text: A buffer's Skill AMP isn't dead: it grows every amp-scaled buff she gives.
detail: +1 point lifts each amp-scaled buff by 1% ÷ (1 + her amp). Milk keeps her Skill AMP line, unless the server excludes ATK.

text: Buff the buffer before she casts: buffs are sized at cast.
detail: A +69% amp beam on Milk (75.8% amp) grows her next buff ~39%, unless ATK skips amp. Later buffs don't count.

text: Don't pay for amp on a debuffer: debuffs never take it.
detail: Push/airborne RES lines add raw too; final DMG lines most likely do (inferred). Those buffers gain from other lines.

text: Don't pair same-group buffs: only the biggest counts.
detail: Largest stack × strength wins on each cookie; check overlap before pairing buffers.

text: Boss DMG is its own bucket: full value on bosses, nothing on adds.
detail: +Δ is worth Δ ÷ (1 + Boss), whatever skill amp or crit hold.

text: Crit: raise whichever of effective crit rate (crit rate − target crit RES) and crit DMG is lower.
detail: Expected crit = 1 + CDR × (CR − CRES), linear past 100%; break-even at CR − CRES = CDR.

text: Light on the Dark Piñata hinges on a server constant: test it.
detail: Dark beats Light too; if C_dec + the boss's element RES > 0, Light deals less than a neutral cookie.

text: Outside Conquest, low team power likely cuts your damage; Conquest holds no penalty.
detail: Arena, stage, Rift and daily dungeon controllers hold a power-tier penalty; that each mode applies it is inferred.

text: Skip Accuracy against targets with no Avoidance: no miss roll happens.
detail: With 0 Avoidance every hit lands; Accuracy only counts against Avoidance.
